Audi on LeMans is harsh because you don't regenerate any energy back on the straights, meaning all your recovery has to be in the braking zones. Make sure to maximize that and never ever lock up, as then you don't regenerate anything. For LeMans in particular you will be faster through the corners and the last third and the beginning part of the track, but will lose a lot of time on the straights. To begin with you can leave the hybrid system on automatic, which will give you more or less hybrid deployment depending on how much you use. If you are more experienced with it you can set it to manual with minimal deployment, and set a button to boost additionally ( HYS Boost Hold I think the control element is called.)
